tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how something works or why something happens in physics, engineering, AI, biology and medicine, earth and space science or mathematics, or asks to see or try a mechanism: e.g. “why do we have seasons”, “how does a jet engine work”, “潮汐是怎么形成的”, “Transformer 的注意力是什么”. Searc

tools.name: show_model
tools.description: Shows one interactive 3D model from world.lapla.si in the conversation, opening at the chapter that answers the user’s question; the user can turn it, step through its chapters and try its lab. Use it after search_models with the slug and chapter (and params) it returned, or when the user names a pl

tools.name: list_chapters
tools.description: Lists one plate’s chapters (ids and titles) and the lab settings it accepts (ids, ranges, options), for show_model. Use it when the user wants another part of a plate than the one search_models gave, or wants to set the lab.
